readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.previewIntro: Once a wallet is connected, this window checks five things live on Robinhood Chain and links each gap to the app that fixes it. An example of a half-ready wallet:

Row 1 reads LOW at or below {{reserve}} ETH (the larger of 0.0003 ETH and {{txs}} transactions' gas), the same amount every ETH → USDG swap leaves behind. Readiness refreshes every 30 s and after every transaction.

receive.title: Receive
receive.copyBlocked: Copy blocked by the browser — select the address above and copy it.
receive.chainOnly: Send ONLY on the Robinhood Chain network (chain ID 4663). The same 0x address exists on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum, but funds sent on those networks stay there — SPARE cannot see or move them.
receive.needs: SPARE needs two things here: a little ETH for gas, and USDG to spend and round up. Other tokens are ignored.

bridge.title: Bridge / Buy
bridge.heading: Get ETH + USDG onto Robinhood Chain
bridge.quickest: Quickest if you use the Robinhood app: buy a few dollars of ETH (gas) and the USDG you want to spend, then send both on the Robinhood Chain network to this wallet. Already hold USDG but no ETH? Every transaction — even the swap below — needs a little ETH first.
bridge.kucoin: KuCoin reportedly supports ETH and USDG withdrawals on a “Robinhood” network (seen only in a post snippet) — confirm the network name on KuCoin's withdrawal screen first.
bridge.others: Coinbase, Kraken (exchange), Binance, OKX, Bybit: no Robinhood Chain deposits or withdrawals found. Withdraw USDC or ETH to Base, Arbitrum or Ethereum, then bridge with Across or Relay.
bridge.legend: LISTED = on Robinhood's official bridging page · PARTNER = announced by the provider. SPARE runs none of these and earns nothing from them.

robinhoodApp.how: Buy ETH and USDG in Robinhood Crypto, then Send → pick the Robinhood Chain network → paste the address above. No Robinhood send fee; only the network fee.
robinhoodApp.caveat: Transfers not available in New York; buying USDG not offered in NY or TX. Crypto bought with instant or uncleared deposits can be on hold.

robinhoodWallet.how: Self-custody wallet with Robinhood Chain built in. Move crypto in from Robinhood Crypto over Robinhood Chain, or connect it here as your SPARE wallet.

moonpay.how: Card, bank transfer, Apple Pay or Google Pay straight to USDG on Robinhood Chain.
moonpay.caveat: Not in New York or Canada; buy only. Buying ETH on Robinhood Chain via MoonPay is unconfirmed — you still need a little ETH for gas.

across.how: USDC from 13 chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Solana…) arrives as USDG in seconds; ETH from the major EVM chains.

relay.caveat: Which source chains it supports is not independently confirmed — check on the page.

stargate.how: Moves USDG from the other chains it is issued on (LayerZero OFT).

arbitrum.name: Arbitrum canonical bridge
arbitrum.how: Trustless, from Ethereum mainnet only. Deposits take about 10 minutes.
arbitrum.caveat: Withdrawing back to Ethereum takes about 7 days plus a final L1 claim.

footer.feeRoute: SPARE fee: {{pct}} of what the pool pays out, skimmed in the same transaction and sent to SPARE's FeeVault <vault/> — USDG when you buy USDG, WETH when you buy ETH. It pays for running SPARE; swapping elsewhere (e.g. Robinhood Wallet) avoids it. Route: Uniswap v4 ETH/USDG {{poolFee}} pool through the Universal Router <router/>. Guards: Chainlink ETH/USD must be under {{hours}} h old with the pool within {{priceBlock}} of it, and price impact under {{impactBlock}} — otherwise the swap is blocked.

Guards: Chainlink ETH/USD must be under {{hours}} h old with the pool within {{priceBlock}} of it, and price impact under {{impactBlock}} — otherwise the swap is blocked.

meaning.title: What linking means
meaning.payments: A payment is an outgoing <info>USDG transfer</info> from a linked wallet. Transfers between your own linked wallets, to your account, to SPARE contracts and into the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (plus the few Uniswap contracts the keeper lists) are not spending and never round up. USDG sent anywhere else counts as a payment — including a swap that pays a Uniswap v3 pool directly, or any other DEX or aggregator. <warn>Pause round-ups before a large swap from a linked wallet.</warn> Linking starts at the block it lands in — it never reaches back to payments made before you consented.
meaning.unlink: <info>Unlink</info> stops new accrual from that wallet immediately (the executor refuses to pull from an unlinked wallet). Spare already collected and stock already bought stay exactly where they are. Either the account or the wallet itself can unlink.

worked.formula: Integer arithmetic in USDG base units, identical to RoundUp.sol: step = roundTo × 1e6, rem = amount mod step, delta = rem = 0 ? 0 : (step − rem) × multiplier. A preview of the rule, not a payment or a holding.

registry.inactiveTitle: INACTIVE in AssetRegistry, so it cannot be elected

universe.title: Eligible Universe · AssetRegistry
universe.staleNote: Stock feeds run 24/5. A feed only turns STALE once its last answer is older than its heartbeat + 1 hour — for a daily feed that is ~25h after the last update, so a sweep can still run through Friday evening into Saturday against Friday's close (the oracle band bounds the fill). Once STALE a sweep <warn>waits</warn> — the spare stays parked and is retried next epoch. It is never converted to a USDG payout because a market is shut. INACTIVE assets (e.g. a thin pool) cannot be elected.

preview.note: Split the way SweepExecutor splits: each leg gets threshold × bps / 10000, the last leg takes the remainder. The {{fee}}% fee applies only to legs that actually convert. Arithmetic, not an order.

detail.low: only {{room}} can still be pulled (USDG→Permit2 {{erc20}}, Permit2→SweepExecutor {{p2}}). A larger pull fails and pulls stop once it is used up — re-authorize to lift it.

detail.off: The rule is off (or capped at $0): no new round-ups accrue. Parked spare can still sweep.
detail.checking: Checking the linked wallets’ pull consent…

detail.notAuthorized: None of the {{n}} linked wallet(s) has authorized pulls, so nothing is being collected — and round-ups from payments made meanwhile may never be collected. Connect each spending wallet and use Link Wallet → Authorize round-ups.
detail.some: Round-ups are collected from {{pullable}} only. Not authorized: {{missing}} — its payments are not being collected.
detail.low: {{n}} linked wallet(s) authorized, but {{low}} can be pulled for less than the weekly cap — re-authorize it in Link Wallet.
detail.on: {{n}} linked wallet(s), all authorized. New round-ups keep adding to the park.
